title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Temporal Effect of the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Diligently Studying and Implementing the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Temporal Effect of the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China"

Fa [2024] No. 135

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Company Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Company Law), as revised for the second time at the seventh session of the Standing Committee of the Fourteenth National People's Congress on December 29, 2023, shall come into force on July 1, 2024. The Company Law adheres to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, comprehensively implements the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, is grounded in China's national conditions, deeply summarizes practical experience, and balances the demands of different stakeholders. It has profound historical significance and great practical significance for deepening the reform of state-owned enterprises, improving the modern enterprise system with Chinese characteristics, improving the property rights protection system, continuously optimizing the business environment, stimulating market innovation vitality, promoting the accelerated development of new quality productive forces, and promoting high-quality development. To resolve the issue of the衔接适用 (transitional application) between the old and new laws after the Company Law comes into effect, the Supreme People's Court has formulated the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Temporal Effect of the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China" (hereinafter referred to as the Provisions). The following notice is hereby given on how to further study, comprehend, and correctly apply the Provisions.

1. Organize study and training in a timely manner

To enable people's courts at all levels to accurately understand and grasp the spirit of the Provisions as soon as possible and to correctly understand and apply them in the trial of cases, people's courts at all levels shall, on the premise of properly handling the relationship between work and study, organize study and training through various forms and carry out publicity work.

2. Accurately apply the Provisions

The principle that laws shall not be retroactive is a fundamental principle of legal application and also the general rule regarding the temporal effect of the Company Law. However, this principle is not absolute. Where the application of the Company Law can better achieve the purpose of legislation, retroactive application is permitted. Since retroactive application is an exception, caution must be exercised when applying it. Where there is a dispute as to whether retroactive application should be made, the standards shall be unified in a timely manner through methods such as using the FatLaw Network (FaDa Wang) or reporting to the higher-level court for jurisdiction. Higher People's Courts shall strengthen business guidance for courts within their jurisdiction and promptly cultivate typical cases for submission to the case database.

It should also be noted that the Provisions, guided by a problem-oriented approach, stipulate specific circumstances for retroactive application based on the characteristics of the Company Law. These provisions obviously do not cover all new or substantively amended provisions of the Company Law. Given that the "General Provisions" of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Temporal Effect of the Application of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China" reveal the general principles of legal application, where the Provisions do not specifically stipulate whether a new or substantively amended provision of the Company Law can be applied retroactively, the "General Provisions" of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Temporal Effect of the Application of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China" may be applied by reference.

3. Establish a hierarchical reporting mechanism

Where the Provisions do not provide for a specific matter, and a people's court deems during the trial of a case that retroactive application of the Company Law is indeed necessary, the matter shall be reported to the Higher People's Court for review, and where necessary, reported to the Supreme People's Court for review.

For any issues arising in the application, please report to the Supreme People's Court in a timely manner.

June 29, 2024
